name: Stormpike's Delivery
label: Quest
description: Following work in the Dwarven District, smith Grimand Elmore entrusts travelers with a newly forged axe destined for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike.…
intro: Following work in the Dwarven District, smith Grimand Elmore entrusts travelers with a newly forged axe destined for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike. Delivering the package requires a trek north through the mountains to an Ironforge outpost in Loch Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes. So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.
The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan. If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?
My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You come all the way from Stormwind? I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about. A perfect place for an adventurer to prove his worth!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! So Grimand finally finished my axe! I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!
Many thanks, friend. It was a long distance to travel for this delivery. Here are some coins for your efforts.
